title: Responsive Design Systems with Modern CSS Grid & Flexbox
author: Samantha Lee
excerpt: Discover the power of CSS Grid and Flexbox for crafting bulletproof fluid layouts that adapt seamlessly to any device screen.
content: Creating a truly responsive website requires combining modern CSS features like CSS custom properties (variables), Flexbox for one-dimensional layouts, and CSS Grid for complex two-dimensional component positioning. We will explore mobile-first media queries, clamp() functions, and responsive typography.

title: Vanilla JavaScript & Node.js REST API Integration
author: David Chen
excerpt: How to connect frontend client applications to Express.js REST endpoints using asynchronous Fetch API.
content: Connecting frontend user interfaces to backend REST endpoints is a fundamental skill in full-stack web development. Using the modern Fetch API with async/await, applications can send asynchronous HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE) with JSON payloads, handle status codes, and update DOM elements reactively without page reloads.
